newsitem.title: JAPAN: Minebea says biggest shareholder to reduce stake.
newsitem.headline: Minebea says biggest shareholder to reduce stake.

text.p: Japan's Minebea Co Ltd said on Wednesday that its biggest shareholder Keiaisha NMB Co Ltd had agreed to sell a total of 20 million Minebea shares to several domestic and overseas investors.
The transfer of shares will take effect July 18.

As a result of the sale, Keiaisha's stake in Minebea will drop to 5.41 percent from the current 10.50 percent, Minebea said in a statement. Minebea declined to specify the names of investors who are to purchase the shares from Keiaisha.
